items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising monetization, and external outreach. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access but not rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize data; current terms restrict the proposed use. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Security and operations sweeps have no results. Accuracy, attribution, measurement, owner, and financial gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any rights-dependent monetization or launch decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Recorded progress includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and private-gate evidence; none establishes launch permission or complete processing controls. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize are not established. Missing evidence: current permission or API agreement, field-level rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate-use terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and unreachable or failed compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
